newsitem.title: USA: Danskin says to be delisted from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Danskin says to be delisted from Nasdaq.

text.p: Danskin Inc. was delisted from the Nasdaq stock market Friday after market authorities concluded that the maker of women's activewear would take too long to regain compliance with its listing standards.
The New York City-based company said it expects its common stock will be eligible for quotation on the OTC bulletin board service.
Danskin's stock, which did not trade Friday, closed Thursday at $1.50. Its 12-month high was $4 and its low was 62.5 cents.
